description: The binary realtime protocol between SimulationWorker and the Unity client. tools/ProtocolGenerator generates Runtime/Generated from this file.

channels.name: ControlChannel
channels.description: Reliable ordered control messages in both directions.

channels.name: MovementInputChannel
channels.description: Sequenced movement input from the client.

channels.name: UnreliableReceiveChannel
channels.description: The channel on which the client receives unreliable snapshots.

limits.name: MaximumIdentifierLength
limits.description: Characters in an identifier such as a session, account, World, or definition id.

limits.name: MaximumNameLength
limits.description: Characters in a display name.

limits.name: MaximumEquipmentSlotIdLength
limits.description: Characters in a canonical equipment slot id.

limits.name: MaximumSlotTagLength
limits.description: Characters in one accepted slot tag.

limits.name: MaximumSlotTags
limits.description: Accepted tags on one slot.

limits.name: MaximumDefinitionIdLength
limits.description: Characters in an item definition id.

limits.name: MaximumInputBatchSize
limits.description: Movement inputs in one batch.

limits.name: MaximumMovementPathWaypoints
limits.description: Waypoints in one movement path; equals MovementPath.MaximumWaypoints in GameSimulation.

limits.name: MaximumSnapshotEntitiesPerChunk
limits.description: Entity records in one simulation snapshot chunk.

limits.name: MaximumTimestampLength
limits.description: Characters in a round-trip timestamp.

limits.name: MaximumErrorCodeLength
limits.description: Characters in an error, closure, or despawn reason code.

limits.name: MaximumErrorMessageLength
limits.description: Characters in a human-readable error or closure message.

limits.name: MaximumJoinTicketLength
limits.description: Characters in a join ticket.

limits.name: MaximumItemOperationItems
limits.description: Item expectations in one recovery claim.

limits.name: MaximumItemResultItemRevisions
limits.description: Committed item revisions in one item operation result.

limits.name: MaximumItemResultContainerRevisions
limits.description: Committed container revisions in one item operation result.

limits.name: MaximumItemStateChanges
limits.description: Changed items in one owner item state change; a larger transaction needs a refresh.

limits.name: MaximumItemPolicies
limits.description: Active policies of one changed item.

limits.name: MaximumItemPolicyTextLength
limits.description: Characters in a policy kind, status, or protection source.

limits.name: MaximumItemResultRecoveryDeliveries
limits.description: Recovery deliveries in one item operation result.

limits.name: MaximumWorldActorCapabilities
limits.description: Capabilities in one opened world interaction.

limits.name: MaximumWorldActorCapabilityIdLength
limits.description: Characters in a world actor capability id.

limits.name: MaximumWorldActorCapabilityNameLength
limits.description: Characters in a world actor capability display name.

limits.name: MaximumWorldActorExamineTextLength
limits.description: Characters in the examine text of a world actor.

limits.name: MaximumWorldActorLevel
limits.description: The highest level of a world actor.

limits.name: MaximumWorldActorMenuOptionLength
limits.description: Characters in the right-click menu option of a world actor capability.

limits.name: MaximumWorldInteractionMessageLength
limits.description: Characters in the optional message of a world interaction result.

limits.name: MaximumCorpsePresencePerChunk
limits.description: Corpses in one presence snapshot chunk.

limits.name: MaximumAppearanceKindLength
limits.description: Characters in the kind of a look, such as underwear.

limits.name: MaximumAppearanceSlotLength
limits.description: Characters in the visual slot of a kind worn per slot, such as legs.

limits.name: MaximumAppearanceNameLength
limits.description: Characters in a body model or an option of a look, such as Human_Female or Freckles.

limits.name: MaximumAppearanceChoices
limits.description: Choices in one look.

limits.name: MaximumVisibleEquipment
limits.description: Equipped items that other players see on one character.

limits.name: MaximumCorpseViewSlotsPerChunk
limits.description: Slots in one corpse view state chunk.

limits.name: MaximumCorpseChunkCount
limits.description: Chunks in one corpse presence snapshot or corpse view update.

limits.name: MaximumCorpseSourceNameLength
limits.description: Characters in the display name of the corpse's source.

limits.name: MaximumCorpsePresentationKeyLength
limits.description: Characters in a corpse presentation key.

limits.name: MaximumCorpseSectionKindLength
limits.description: Characters in a corpse view section kind.

limits.name: MaximumCorpseSlotKindLength
limits.description: Characters in a corpse slot kind.

limits.name: MaximumCorpseSectionSlotCapacity
limits.description: Slots in one corpse view section.

limits.name: MaximumCombatEventsPerBatch
limits.description: Combat events in one event batch; more events split into several batches.

limits.name: MinimumAdminSpeedPercent
limits.description: The slowest walk speed a development admin chooses, in percent of the World's walk speed.

limits.name: MaximumAdminSpeedPercent
limits.description: The fastest walk speed a development admin chooses, in percent of the World's walk speed.

enums.name: EntityKind
enums.description: The kind of a replicated simulation entity.

enums.name: ItemOperationKind
enums.description: An in-world item operation.

enums.name: CorpseInteractionKind
enums.description: An operation on an open corpse.

enums.name: CorpseViewUpdateKind
enums.description: Whether a corpse view chunk replaces the view or applies a delta.

enums.name: WorldActorKind
enums.description: The kind of a world actor.

enums.name: WorldActorDisposition
enums.description: How a world actor treats players.

enums.name: WorldActorAggression
enums.description: Whether a Mob attacks the players it detects or fights only once damaged; None for an actor without a brain.

enums.name: WorldActorActivityTier
enums.description: How often the worker updates a world actor.

enums.name: WorldInteractionTargetKind
enums.description: What a world interaction targets.

enums.name: WorldInteractionOperationKind
enums.description: A world interaction operation.

enums.name: WorldActorCapabilityKind
enums.description: A service that a world actor offers.

enums.name: CapabilityActionKind
enums.description: The action a capability performs, beyond opening it.

enums.name: GatheringStateKind
enums.description: A change of a character's gathering at a resource node.

enums.name: CombatIntentKind
enums.description: What a combat intent asks for.

enums.name: AppearanceIntentKind
enums.description: What an appearance intent asks for.

enums.name: CombatLifeState
enums.description: Whether a combatant lives, is dead, or is a Mob walking home.

enums.name: CombatAttackStatus
enums.description: Why the owner's attack releases or waits. It changes every tick, so it is a status and not an error.

enums.name: CombatAttackStyle
enums.description: The combat style of a started or released attack, which selects how it is presented, such as an arrow or a magic bolt.

enums.name: CombatEventKind
enums.description: The kind of a combat event.

enums.name: CombatDamageType
enums.description: The damage type of a hit, which selects its presentation color.

enums.name: ItemQuantityChangeReason
enums.description: Why the worker changed an item quantity without a client intent.

enums.name: AdminIntentKind
enums.description: What a development admin intent asks for.

enums.name: ItemStateLocationKind
enums.description: Where a changed item is after its transaction.

structs.name: PlayerState
structs.description: The authoritative movement state of one player.

fields.name: PositionX
fields.description: World position on the x axis in meters.

fields.name: PositionY
fields.description: World position on the y axis in meters.

fields.name: PositionZ
fields.description: World position on the z axis in meters.

fields.name: VelocityX
fields.description: Velocity on the x axis in meters per second.

fields.name: VelocityY
fields.description: Velocity on the y axis in meters per second.

fields.name: VelocityZ
fields.description: Velocity on the z axis in meters per second.

fields.name: YawDegrees
fields.description: Facing around the vertical axis in degrees.

fields.name: Flags
fields.description: Movement state bits.

bits.name: IsGrounded
bits.description: The player stands on walkable ground.

structs.name: MovementSettings
structs.description: Movement and collision settings that client prediction shares with the worker.

fields.name: TickRateHz
fields.description: Simulation ticks per second.

fields.name: SnapshotRateHz
fields.description: Snapshots per second; divides the tick rate.

fields.name: WalkSpeed
fields.description: Walking speed in meters per second.

fields.name: RotationSpeedDegrees
fields.description: Turn rate in degrees per second.

fields.name: Gravity
fields.description: Vertical acceleration in meters per second squared.

fields.name: MaximumFallSpeed
fields.description: Terminal fall speed in meters per second.

fields.name: GroundedVerticalVelocity
fields.description: Vertical velocity that keeps a grounded player on the ground.

fields.name: GroundHeight
fields.description: Height of the fallback ground plane in meters.

fields.name: MinimumX
fields.description: Western world bound in meters; below the eastern bound.

fields.name: MaximumX
fields.description: Eastern world bound in meters.

fields.name: MinimumZ
fields.description: Southern world bound in meters; below the northern bound.

fields.name: MaximumZ
fields.description: Northern world bound in meters.

fields.name: CharacterRadius
fields.description: Capsule radius in meters.

fields.name: CharacterHeight
fields.description: Capsule height in meters; at least twice the radius.

fields.name: StepHeight
fields.description: Highest step in meters; below the capsule height.

fields.name: MaximumSlopeDegrees
fields.description: Steepest walkable slope in degrees.

fields.name: GroundSnapDistance
fields.description: Distance in meters within which a player snaps to the ground.

fields.name: MaximumSubstepDistance
fields.description: Longest collision substep in meters; at most the radius.

fields.name: MaximumPenetrationIterations
fields.description: Collision depenetration passes per substep.

structs.name: MovementInput
structs.description: One tick of movement intent: the path the player follows.

fields.name: InputSequence
fields.description: Increases by one with every input.

fields.name: ClientTick
fields.description: The client simulation tick of the input.

fields.name: PathId
fields.description: The movement path to follow, or 0 to stand still.

structs.name: MovementPathWaypoint
structs.description: One waypoint of a movement path, on the walkable surface.

fields.name: X
fields.description: World position on the x axis in meters.

fields.name: Y
fields.description: World position on the y axis in meters.

fields.name: Z
fields.description: World position on the z axis in meters.

structs.name: MovementPath
structs.description: A client-planned path. The worker validates it and moves along it with authoritative collision.

fields.name: PathId
fields.description: Identifies the path within the session.

fields.name: Waypoints
fields.description: The waypoints after the start, in order.

structs.name: MovementPathProgress
structs.description: How far the owner has followed its movement path. Without a path, the index and the blocked ticks are 0.

fields.name: PathId
fields.description: The followed path, or 0 for none.

fields.name: NextWaypointIndex
fields.description: The waypoint the owner moves toward; the waypoint count once the path ended.

fields.name: BlockedTicks
fields.description: Consecutive ticks in which collision blocked the path.

structs.name: EntitySnapshot
structs.description: The state of one remote entity in a simulation snapshot.

fields.name: EntityId
fields.description: The network entity id.

fields.name: LastProcessedInputSequence
fields.description: The newest input sequence the worker applied for the entity.

fields.name: State
fields.description: The entity's authoritative movement state.

structs.name: Error
structs.description: A structured error: a stable code for programs and a message for people.

fields.name: Code
fields.description: A stable, machine-readable code.

fields.name: Message
fields.description: A human-readable explanation.

structs.name: CarryState
structs.description: The committed carry weight of a character. Weight above the capacity is valid: death can leave an involuntary overflow.

fields.name: ItemStateRevision
fields.description: The committed item-state revision of the character.

fields.name: CarriedWeight
fields.description: The unitless carried weight.

fields.name: CarryCapacity
fields.description: The unitless carry capacity.

structs.name: ItemRevisionExpectation
structs.description: An item and the revision the client expects it to have.

fields.name: ItemInstanceId
fields.description: The item.

fields.name: Revision
fields.description: The expected item revision.

structs.name: ItemRevision
structs.description: An item and the revision an operation committed.

fields.name: ItemInstanceId
fields.description: The item.

fields.name: Revision
fields.description: The committed item revision.

structs.name: ContainerRevision
structs.description: A container and the revision an operation committed.

fields.name: ContainerId
fields.description: The container.

fields.name: Revision
fields.description: The committed container revision.

structs.name: ItemPolicySummary
structs.description: An active policy of an item, as the inventory snapshot shows it.

fields.name: Kind
fields.description: The policy kind.

fields.name: Status
fields.description: The policy status.

fields.name: ProtectionSource
fields.description: Where the protection came from.

structs.name: ItemStateChange
structs.description: One item after a committed transaction. A removed item carries only its id; an item in a container carries no equipment slot, and an equipped item no container.

fields.name: ItemInstanceId
fields.description: The item.

fields.name: Location
fields.description: Where the item is now.

fields.name: DefinitionId
fields.description: The item definition, or empty for a removed item.

fields.name: Quantity
fields.description: The stack quantity, or 0 for a removed item.

fields.name: Revision
fields.description: The item revision, or 0 for a removed item.

fields.name: ContainerId
fields.description: The container of a contained item, or empty.

fields.name: SlotIndex
fields.description: The container slot of a contained item, or -1.

fields.name: EquipmentSlotId
fields.description: The equipment slot of an equipped item, or empty.

fields.name: Policies
fields.description: The active policies of the item; empty for a removed item.

fields.name: BagContentsContainerId
fields.description: The contents container of a Bag in the Bag equipment slot, or empty.

fields.name: BagContentsRevision
fields.description: The revision of that contents container, or 0 without one.

structs.name: WorldActorCapability
structs.description: A service that a world actor offers in an open interaction.

fields.name: Id
fields.description: The capability.

fields.name: Kind
fields.description: The kind of service.

fields.name: DisplayName
fields.description: The name the client shows.

fields.name: ProfileId
fields.description: The vendor or resource profile of the capability, or empty.

fields.name: IsAvailable
fields.description: Whether the character can use the capability now.

fields.name: Revision
fields.description: The capability revision an action must expect.

structs.name: WorldActorMenuOption
structs.description: A capability of a world actor as the right-click menu offers it before the interaction opens.

fields.name: CapabilityId
fields.description: The capability the option opens.

fields.name: Kind
fields.description: The kind of service.

fields.name: Label
fields.description: The verb the menu shows before the actor's name, such as Trade.

structs.name: AppearanceChoice
structs.description: One choice of a character's look: an option of a kind, in a slot for a kind worn per slot.

fields.name: Kind
fields.description: The kind of look, such as face, tattoo, underwear, or hair.

fields.name: Slot
fields.description: The visual slot of a kind worn per slot, such as legs for underwear, or empty.

fields.name: Option
fields.description: The chosen option, such as Clean or DarkBrownHair.

structs.name: VisibleEquipment
structs.description: An equipped item that other players see on a character, by its definition, which names the garments it shows.

fields.name: EquipmentSlotId
fields.description: The equipment slot, such as back.

fields.name: DefinitionId
fields.description: The item definition.

structs.name: CharacterAppearance
structs.description: How a character looks to every client: its body model, the choices of its look, the items others see on it, whether it lowered its headwear, and the tool it holds while it uses it.

fields.name: BodyModel
fields.description: The body model, such as Human_Female.

fields.name: Choices
fields.description: The choices of the look, such as its face, eyes, tattoo, underwear, and hair.

fields.name: Equipment
fields.description: The items others see on the character, one per equipment slot.

fields.name: HeadwearLowered
fields.description: Whether the character lowered its headwear, such as a hood pushed back.

fields.name: ToolInUse
fields.description: The item definition of the tool the character holds while it uses it, such as its pickaxe while it gathers, or empty.

structs.name: CorpsePresence
structs.description: A corpse near the character, as the world shows it before it is opened.

fields.name: CorpseId
fields.description: The corpse.

fields.name: PositionX
fields.description: The position on the x axis.

fields.name: PositionY
fields.description: The position on the y axis.

fields.name: PositionZ
fields.description: The position on the z axis.

fields.name: YawDegrees
fields.description: The facing of whoever left the corpse around the vertical axis in degrees, so the remains lie as the body fell.

fields.name: ExpiresAtUnixMilliseconds
fields.description: When the corpse decays.

fields.name: IsEmpty
fields.description: Whether the corpse holds no items.

fields.name: SourceDisplayName
fields.description: The name of whoever left the corpse.

fields.name: PresentationKey
fields.description: The presentation the client renders.

fields.name: Appearance
fields.description: How a player corpse looks: the dead character's body model and look, wearing the items still in its equipment section; absent for a Mob corpse.

structs.name: CorpseItem
structs.description: An item in a corpse slot.

fields.name: ItemInstanceId
fields.description: The item.

fields.name: DefinitionId
fields.description: The item definition.

fields.name: Quantity
fields.description: The stack quantity.

fields.name: Revision
fields.description: The item revision.

fields.name: BagContentsContainerId
fields.description: The contents of a bag item, or empty.

fields.name: BagContentsRevision
fields.description: The bag contents revision, or 0 without contents.

structs.name: CorpseSlot
structs.description: One slot of a corpse section and the item in it.

fields.name: SlotIndex
fields.description: The slot within its section.

fields.name: SlotKind
fields.description: The kind of slot.

fields.name: AcceptedTags
fields.description: The item tags the slot accepts.

fields.name: EquipmentSlotId
fields.description: The equipment slot, in the equipment section only.

fields.name: Item
fields.description: The item in the slot, or null.

structs.name: ShardRules
structs.description: The gameplay rules of the Shard that hosts the session.

fields.name: PlayerVersusPlayer
fields.description: Whether characters may attack other characters.

structs.name: CombatEvent
structs.description: One combat event. Fields that the kind does not use are 0.

fields.name: Kind
fields.description: What happened.

fields.name: SourceEntityId
fields.description: The attacker or killer, or 0 when none is known.

fields.name: TargetEntityId
fields.description: The combatant the event is about.

fields.name: Tick
fields.description: For a started attack, the server tick at which it releases; for a released attack, the server tick at which it hits.

fields.name: Damage
fields.description: For a hit, the damage dealt.

fields.name: DamageType
fields.description: For a hit, the damage type; Normal otherwise.

fields.name: HealthAfter
fields.description: For a hit, the target's health afterwards.

fields.name: AttackStyle
fields.description: For a started, released, or cancelled attack, the combat style of the attack; Melee otherwise.

messages.name: JoinRequest
messages.description: Asks to join a simulation session with a join ticket.

fields.name: JoinTicket
fields.description: The join ticket that GameService issued for this session.

messages.name: JoinAccepted
messages.description: Accepts a join and carries the session, movement settings, and initial state.

fields.name: SimulationSessionId
fields.description: The simulation session.

fields.name: AccountId
fields.description: The account that joined.

fields.name: CharacterId
fields.description: The character that joined.

fields.name: CharacterName
fields.description: The display name of the character.

fields.name: ShardId
fields.description: The shard that hosts the session.

fields.name: WorldId
fields.description: The world the character is in.

fields.name: ControlledEntityId
fields.description: The entity the client controls.

fields.name: SimulationRevision
fields.description: The simulation content revision of the worker.

fields.name: CollisionRevision
fields.description: The collision content revision of the worker.

fields.name: JoinedAt
fields.description: When the session started, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

fields.name: SessionExpiresAt
fields.description: When the session expires, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

fields.name: IsReconnect
fields.description: Whether this join resumed an earlier session.

fields.name: CarryState
fields.description: The committed carry state of the character.

fields.name: MovementSettings
fields.description: The movement settings the client must predict with.

fields.name: InitialPlayerState
fields.description: The authoritative state of the controlled entity at join.

fields.name: ShardRules
fields.description: The gameplay rules of the Shard.

messages.name: JoinRejected
messages.description: Rejects a join with a structured error.

fields.name: Rejection
fields.description: Why the join failed.

messages.name: LeaveRequest
messages.description: Asks to leave the active simulation session.

fields.name: SimulationSessionId
fields.description: The simulation session to leave.

messages.name: LeaveAccepted
messages.description: Confirms a leave.

messages.name: LeaveRejected
messages.description: Rejects a leave with a structured error.

fields.name: Rejection
fields.description: Why the leave failed.

messages.name: ServerDisconnect
messages.description: Tells the client why the worker ends the connection.

fields.name: Reason
fields.description: Why the worker ends the connection.

messages.name: MovementInputBatch
messages.description: The newest movement inputs, oldest first, and the path of the newest input until the worker confirmed it.

fields.name: Inputs
fields.description: The newest inputs, oldest first. Each input is sent in several batches.

fields.name: Path
fields.description: The path of the newest input; its id equals that input's path id.

messages.name: SimulationSnapshot
messages.description: One chunk of the remote entity states visible to the recipient.

fields.name: SnapshotSequence
fields.description: Increases with every snapshot frame.

fields.name: ServerTick
fields.description: The worker simulation tick of the states.

fields.name: ChunkIndex
fields.description: The position of this chunk in its frame.

fields.name: ChunkCount
fields.description: The number of chunks in the frame.

fields.name: Entities
fields.description: The entity states in this chunk.

messages.name: EntitySpawn
messages.description: An entity entered the recipient's interest.

fields.name: EntityId
fields.description: The network entity id.

fields.name: Kind
fields.description: The kind of entity.

fields.name: PersistentId
fields.description: The persistent id, such as the character id.

fields.name: DisplayName
fields.description: The name shown for the entity.

fields.name: ArchetypeId
fields.description: The presentation archetype.

fields.name: ServerTick
fields.description: The worker simulation tick of the initial state.

fields.name: InitialState
fields.description: The movement state when the entity entered interest.

fields.name: Appearance
fields.description: How the character looks when it entered interest.

messages.name: EntityDespawn
messages.description: An entity left the recipient's interest.

fields.name: EntityId
fields.description: The network entity id.

fields.name: Reason
fields.description: Why the entity left interest, as a code.

messages.name: CarryStateChanged
messages.description: A newer committed carry state.

fields.name: CarryState
fields.description: The newer committed carry state.

messages.name: ItemOperationIntent
messages.description: Asks for one in-world item operation.

fields.name: OperationId
fields.description: Identifies the operation and its result.

fields.name: OperationKind
fields.description: The operation.

fields.name: ExpectedCharacterRevision
fields.description: The character item-state revision the client saw.

fields.name: ItemInstanceId
fields.description: The item the operation moves or changes.

fields.name: ExpectedItemRevision
fields.description: The item revision the client saw.

fields.name: TargetItemInstanceId
fields.description: The second item of a merge or swap.

fields.name: ExpectedTargetItemRevision
fields.description: The second item's revision the client saw.

fields.name: DestinationContainerId
fields.description: The container the item moves into.

fields.name: DestinationSlotIndex
fields.description: The destination slot, or -1 for any free slot.

fields.name: Quantity
fields.description: The quantity that a split moves.

fields.name: EquipmentSlotId
fields.description: The canonical equipment slot that the item is equipped into.

fields.name: RecoveryDeliveryId
fields.description: The Recovery delivery that a claim takes items from.

fields.name: ExpectedRecoveryDeliveryRevision
fields.description: The delivery revision the client saw.

fields.name: Items
fields.description: The claimed items and their expected revisions.

messages.name: ItemOperationResult
messages.description: The committed or rejected outcome of an item operation.

fields.name: OperationId
fields.description: The operation that this result answers.

fields.name: OperationKind
fields.description: The kind of the operation.

fields.name: Succeeded
fields.description: Whether the operation committed.

fields.name: RequiresInventoryRefresh
fields.description: Whether the client must reload its inventory.

fields.name: CarryState
fields.description: The committed carry state after the operation.

fields.name: Error
fields.description: Why the operation failed.

fields.name: ItemRevisions
fields.description: The committed item revisions; empty when the operation failed.

fields.name: ContainerRevisions
fields.description: The committed container revisions; empty when the operation failed.

fields.name: RecoveryDeliveryIds
fields.description: The Recovery deliveries the operation changed; empty when the operation failed.

messages.name: CorpsePresenceSnapshotChunk
messages.description: One chunk of the corpses near the recipient.

fields.name: SnapshotSequence
fields.description: The snapshot this chunk belongs to.

fields.name: ChunkIndex
fields.description: The position of this chunk in the snapshot.

fields.name: ChunkCount
fields.description: The number of chunks in the snapshot.

fields.name: Corpses
fields.description: The corpses in this chunk.

messages.name: CorpseInteractionIntent
messages.description: Asks for one operation on a corpse.

fields.name: OperationId
fields.description: Identifies the operation and its result.

fields.name: OperationKind
fields.description: The operation.

fields.name: CorpseId
fields.description: The corpse.

fields.name: ExpectedCorpseRevision
fields.description: The corpse revision the client saw, or -1 for Open.

fields.name: ItemInstanceId
fields.description: The item that moves, or the corpse bag of a bag swap.

fields.name: ExpectedItemRevision
fields.description: The item revision the client saw.

fields.name: Quantity
fields.description: The quantity a partial stack moves.

fields.name: DestinationContainerId
fields.description: The container the item moves into.

fields.name: ExpectedDestinationContainerRevision
fields.description: The destination container revision the client saw.

fields.name: DestinationSlotIndex
fields.description: The destination slot.

fields.name: TargetItemInstanceId
fields.description: The stack the item merges into, the equipped item it swaps with, or empty.

fields.name: ExpectedTargetItemRevision
fields.description: The target stack revision the client saw.

fields.name: CorpseBagContentsContainerId
fields.description: The contents of the corpse bag.

fields.name: ExpectedCorpseBagContentsRevision
fields.description: The corpse bag contents revision the client saw.

fields.name: PlayerBagItemInstanceId
fields.description: The bag of the character.

fields.name: ExpectedPlayerBagRevision
fields.description: The character bag revision the client saw.

fields.name: PlayerBagContentsContainerId
fields.description: The contents of the character bag.

fields.name: ExpectedPlayerBagContentsRevision
fields.description: The character bag contents revision the client saw.

fields.name: EquipmentSlotId
fields.description: The equipment slot that a looted item is equipped into.

messages.name: CorpseInteractionResult
messages.description: The committed or rejected outcome of a corpse operation.

fields.name: OperationId
fields.description: The operation this answers.

fields.name: OperationKind
fields.description: The operation.

fields.name: CorpseId
fields.description: The corpse.

fields.name: Succeeded
fields.description: Whether the operation committed.

fields.name: RequiresCorpseRefresh
fields.description: Whether the client must refresh the corpse view.

fields.name: RequiresInventoryRefresh
fields.description: Whether the client must refresh its inventory.

fields.name: CarryState
fields.description: The committed carry state after the operation.

fields.name: Error
fields.description: Why the operation failed.

messages.name: CorpseViewStateChunk
messages.description: One chunk of the open corpse view.

fields.name: UpdateId
fields.description: The update this chunk belongs to.

fields.name: UpdateKind
